data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2018 Syndicate 33 carried gross claims outstanding of $2,519.918m at the opening of the year (31/12/2017). The technical provisions note shows an over-provision in respect of prior claims of $390.991m (gross), representing a material release in the year driven by favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries across multiple lines (notably property and related reinsurance). The underwriting reports note a separate $70.6m release from closed years of 2015 and prior and describe material impacts from the 2017 hurricane season (Harvey/Irma/Maria) and 2018 catastrophe activity which affected individual years of account.

The 2017 account will pick up almost all of the reinsurance loss from the 2017 hurricanes, together with a share of direct property loss.
The 2018 account will pick up almost all of the reinsurance loss from the 2018 hurricane, typhoon and wildfire losses together with a relatively modest share of direct property loss.
The 2016 pure year made a profit with a particularly strong contribution from the reinsurance and insurance property accounts which experienced benign loss activity in 2016 calendar years.

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are taken from the Syndicate 33 annual accounts which are presented in US Dollars from 1 Jan 2018. Opening reserves taken from the balance sheet (gross claims outstanding, prior-year column). Prior year development used the 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses' gross figure from the Technical Provisions note. Some LOB-level prior year movements are not quantified by class in the notes; several event impacts are described qualitatively rather than quantified. Page references approximate to the printed report pagination.
